reviews.title: 2nd Ninja Coffee Machine and it just gets better!
reviews.body: Imagine spending $400 on a drip coffee maker and throwing it out in less than a year.  Yeap, replaced a Moccamaster with a Ninja Specialty and I could not be happier.  Love coffee, mostly drink 4-6 cups of freshly ground coffee a day.  I had an older basic Ninja for several years before giving it to my son and wife, thinking it was a win win, so that when I visited I could enjoy a great cup of coffee, while at home I thought I would upgrade to a superior coffee machine (Moccamaster recommended by Wirecutter).  The Moccamaster was a rip off.  Could not fathom spending that kind of money, just to throw it away.  Right?  Tolerated it for less than a year then couldn't stand it anymore. In the garbage it went.  Lesson learned.Ninja Specialty surpasses my expectation.  First it makes excellent coffee.  Can choose classic or bold, cup, mug, half or full pot, and the machine adjusts accordingly.  The ease of use now is great, don't have to pull the machine out from under the cabinet anymore since the filter holder pulls out the front area.  The water reservoir can also be removed from the side and be filled or washed.  Has its own scoop that shows how much coffee is recommended depending on the brew cycle.  Have not tried the frother yet.  Another improvement is that if you want to grab a cup before the brew finishes you just move a lever to the left, which pauses the brew,  this is important because all the machines I ever had, when you pull the carafe out, some coffee drops still drip on the hot plate which fizzles and stains the base.  What a great great well thought out and tested machine.  Highly recommend!Ninja appears to build products that are built around what their customers want while others appear to build products based on profitability and greed, using their brand well initially as a trap then turning their goods into garbage and charging excessively for inferior products.  Again, lesson learned.

reviews.title: Flawless; more convenient than k-cups
reviews.body: Been using this daily for about a year now. Perfect coffee maker. It’s essentially an automatic pour over (with multiple water streams instead of just one), and it’s extremely easy to use and clean.Cleaning just requires lifting and dumping the bag of grounds in the trash; the grounds holder is extremely easy to remove from the machine. Water tank holds plenty of water and is easy to fill.I did an absurd amount of research into an automatic pour over (to replace k-cup dependency) and this product checks all the boxes. I was willing to drop $$$ for the super expensive ones, but none of them match the level of quality / convenience.Flawless.Pair with a grinder and it becomes quicker and easier than a k-cup machine. And the quality is as close as you’ll get to a hand-made pourover.

reviews.title: Outstanding, well-designed 'NinJoe'
reviews.body: I was impressed with the well-thought out design, quality, looks and ease of use. If you take the time to read the instructions ( which are thorough and clear) and experiment with the four types of coffee settings and 8 different sizes offered, you'll be rewarded with wonderful coffee every time. Sounds complicated but after you use it a couple times , it's a snap.  There's even a coffee scoop attached to the side of the unit with two different size scoops (with instructions) so you don't have to go hunting for one. You can have one cup or a whole pot just as easily. It's not a K-Cup design but it's surprisingly fast and it makes superior coffee for much less money per cup. The large detachable reservoir is easily refilled and clear so that you can see the amount of water that's left. The hot plate temperature and timer can be adjusted so as not to overheat your carafe of coffee. There are even two types of iced coffee and it produces strong coffee specifically made so that the ice does not dilute it. It comes with a nice plastic mesh reusable coffee filter or you can use your own paper filters. The basket even swings out for ease of access with a switch that stops all coffee from leaking out when you are tossing the filter or taking some coffee from the carafe. I use three different kinds of coffee in my basket to hone my brew depending on how I'm feeling. What could be better and no K-Cup stress? I'll tell you, my wife loves it too!

reviews.title: Early days, happy so far
reviews.body: I bought this coffee maker as a replacement for my Cuisinart PurePrecision after our second glass carafe broke and we are still waiting for the replacement we ordered 3 months ago.  :-(My priority was a great cup of coffee and I used the SCA Certification as a way to quickly narrow down options.  I then looked at countless reviews, videos, etc. I was on the fence about getting a coffee maker from Ninja -- if it had too much going on to do any one thing particularly well.  However, for the comparatively low price compared to other options I looked at -- and the fact that we are pretty happy with other Ninja appliances -- I decided to give it a try.We've been using for only one week, but here's initial impressions:Pros:1. Makes very good coffee.  I made it on the settings that were used for its "gold cup" certification, and also on the "rich" mode.  I've also made a single cup.  I haven't tried over ice or specialty yet.  I have a nespresso and I think that's just going to be easier if I want "specialty".  Also -- for people who like their coffee hot, this is your machine!  I actually let the coffee cool a bit in the cup to release the flavors before I drink mine.2. Removable water tank -- I hate when grounds get into an integrated tank and there's really no easy way to keep it clean.3. Glass carafe seems like it will be durable (see Cuisinart issue above)4. Can customize brew strength and change the warming plate settings (time, and low/high)5. Versatility to make single cup of various sizes, half or full carafeCon's:1. We made our first full carafe and the grounds hit the top of the coffee maker and made a mess.  (not sure if our grounds were too fine or what - but we used the amount used in the SCA certification)2. No easy way to make between a half and full carafe (there's not the standard 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 cup markers).  Although, I assume that's something I can play with and figure out.  But half carafe is usually enough for two of us.3. When you make a full carafe, the water fill line in the tank is very close to the top -- so you really can't fill the tank directly (like from our refrigerator water dispenser) because it spills when you walk.  You really need to use a separate vessel to fill the tank.4. The stop-drip doesn't always work right away, so there can be a couple of drips -- but the nice thing is that the warming plate must have a coating that prevents the drip from burning the plate5. Size -- this is not a small machine so make sure you have roomI've come to accept that all coffee makers have some issues.  I think these are manageable on this one and since I didn't shell out $300+ I am OK living with them.

reviews.title: Wow this is Amazing, A++ Reviewing Over 15 Years
reviews.body: Ninja Hot & Iced XL Coffee Maker Review: The Ultimate Coffee Brewer for Every MoodThe Ninja Hot & Iced XL Coffee Maker (CM371) is a game-changer for coffee enthusiasts, offering incredible versatility, sleek design, and outstanding performance at a fantastic price point. Whether you're a fan of hot coffee, iced drinks, or crave cold brew in minutes, this coffee maker delivers.Why It Stands Out1. Versatile Brew StylesWith 4 brew styles—Classic, Rich, Over Ice, and Cold Brew—you can craft your coffee exactly the way you like it. The cold brew function is especially impressive, delivering a smooth, rich coffee in just 10 minutes without the usual hours-long wait.2. Multiple Brew SizesThis machine doesn’t just serve individuals—it caters to every situation. With 8 brew sizes ranging from small cups to an XL travel mug or even a 12-cup carafe, it’s perfect for solo mornings, family brunches, or fueling the entire office.3. Iced Coffee That’s Never WateryThe "Over Ice" setting brews coffee directly over ice with a bold flavor profile, ensuring your drink stays full of taste, not watered down. This feature alone makes it a must-have for iced coffee lovers.4. Thoughtful DesignThe removable reservoir with auto-metering is a genius addition. It not only eliminates the need for manual measuring but also makes refilling and cleaning a breeze. The permanent filter saves money and reduces waste, and its programmable features let you wake up to the perfect brew.5. Superior Coffee QualityEquipped with Thermal Flavor Extraction technology, the Ninja ensures even saturation and precise temperature control for perfectly brewed coffee every time. Its 1550 watts of power provide fast and consistent performance.6. Eco-Friendly and Pod-FreeSay goodbye to plastic pod waste! This machine gives you unlimited variety with your own coffee grounds, making it both customizable and environmentally friendly.Price and ValueAt just $99.99 (Black Friday deal), this coffee maker is a steal compared to its $149.99 list price. The option for interest-free payments makes it even more accessible. Considering its range of features and versatility, it offers outstanding value for both casual drinkers and coffee aficionados.Pros4 customizable brew styles8 brew sizes, from single-serve to 12-cup carafeIced coffee and cold brew functionsRemovable reservoir with auto-metering for conveniencePermanent filter reduces waste and saves moneyNo pods required for unlimited coffee varietyCompact and modern design for any kitchenConsGlass carafe may not retain heat as long as a thermal optionSlightly larger footprint compared to simpler machinesFinal VerdictThe Ninja Hot & Iced XL Coffee Maker is more than a coffee machine—it’s a personal barista. Its ability to brew everything from rich hot coffee to perfectly crafted iced drinks sets it apart. With its innovative features, eco-friendly design, and unbeatable price, this coffee maker is a must-have for anyone who takes their coffee seriously.Rating: 4.8/5 starsWhether you’re a casual coffee drinker or a brewing enthusiast, this Ninja will elevate your coffee game to the next level. Highly recommended!
